div.div:
by construction
Sv = 0 and every ceiling hold exactly at v*; the pool holds exactly on Eg
feasible for every genotype by construction: the zero flux with full slack satisfies every row and bound
a genotype that cannot meet its maintenance pays M per unit unmet, so z* goes negative
arm flux_projection_anchored_nodiss: no dissipation hinge; Gibbs dissipation is logged only

div.div:
measured (round 18 calibration)
calibration through the layer at initialization: at ceiling scale 1 the maintenance shortfall is 0.54 of 0.70 mmol/gDW/h with zero growth; from scale 10 no slack; a gene-owned bound carries a dual on 97 percent of genotypes at scales 30 to 3,000
